pairs.gold_text: Yelverton Minerals and the independent panel revised its policy during the later response.
pairs.system_text: Yelverton Minerals and the independent panel revised its policy following the landslide.

pairs.gold_text: The independent panel and mines inspectorate met in Dreth during the later response.
pairs.system_text: Yelverton Minerals and the mines inspectorate met, and the independent panel and mines inspectorate met in Dreth.

unmatched_gold.text: Yelverton Minerals and mines inspectorate met during the later response.

pairs.gold_text: Community support was organized in Withel terraces during community recovery.
pairs.system_text: Community support was organized in the Withel terraces.

pairs.gold_text: Ashfell slide damaged the lower road.
pairs.system_text: The Ashfell slide damaged the lower road in Withel, and damage occurred in Dreth and the Pellan.

unmatched_gold.text: Damage was reported in Dreth and the Pellan during the Ashfell slide.

pairs.gold_text: Service was restored in Dreth and the Pellan during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: The lower road was restored by Yelverton Minerals and the operator, and service was restored in Dreth and the Pellan.

unmatched_gold.text: Yelverton Minerals restored the lower road during the Ashfell slide.

pairs.gold_text: Service at Corvane mine was disrupted during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: Service was disrupted in the Ashfell bench, upper bench, and at the Corvane mine and pit, with additional disruptions reported at the lower road.

unmatched_gold.text: Service at the lower road was disrupted during the Ashfell slide.

pairs.gold_text: 60 households were displaced from Cranmoor during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: Sixty households were displaced from Cranmoor, with people moved away from the area as part of displacement efforts.

pairs.gold_text: About 60 households were evacuated from Withel terraces during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: About 60 households were evacuated from Withel terraces and the bench, including the upper bench, as part of evacuation efforts.

unmatched_gold.text: People were evacuated from Ashfell bench during evacuation and displacement operations.
Assistance was received in Cranmoor as response operations continued.

unmatched_system.text: Yelverton Minerals restored the lower road, and the operator restored the lower road following the landslide.
Information was provided about the tailings dam in Withel on multiple occasions.

pairs.gold_text: A warning was issued for Withel terraces and Cranmoor during emergency communications.
pairs.system_text: A warning was issued for the Withel terraces and Cranmoor areas due to the Ashfell slide.

pairs.gold_text: Assistance was provided in Withel terraces during relief operations.
pairs.system_text: Assistance was provided in Withel terraces and received in Cranmoor.
